thread:
Alex Chen: Quick idea — proposal for a side-by-side console affordance so customers can run v1 and v2 concurrently per-route. Badge + per-tenant toggle + sticky routing. Telemetry captures version split, latency/cost deltas, and a small shadow sample for quality checks. Thoughts?

Maria Gomez: Love the idea. Two immediate questions: how do we handle quotas/billing (do we split buckets?) and what does the initial rollout look like (sampling %)?

Samir Patel: Routing detail: prefer an explicit header (e.g., X-Redwood-Version) and persist session affinity server-side. If header absent, default to tenant preference. For coexistence we need sticky routing + deterministic hashing so experiments are stable.

Kevin Wu: Telemetry concerns — start with very small shadow (1%) and expand. Key metrics to add: per-version p50/p90/p99 latency, token_cost_delta, version_switch_rate, and error_delta_v2_vs_v1. Add alerts on >10% latency regression or >5% error rate delta.

Olivia Park: UX sketch thoughts: badge states = [Available, Canary 1%, Opt-in, Enabled]. Tooltip explains what each state means and links to rollout docs. Also add a per-route preview/dry-run button to replay a sample request against v2.

Alex Chen: Quick config example for routing header:

POST /v1/completions
Host: api.redwood.com
X-Redwood-Version: v2
X-Session-Affinity: true

Alex Chen: Note: header approach lets customers test without changing route paths. Server will record both chosen version and reason (explicit header | tenant opt-in | fallback) for telemetry.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary-shadow job scheduled for v2-shadow-run — 2026-04-01T03:00Z :white_check_mark:

Samir Patel: Billing + quotas — recommend separate quota buckets visible in Console: shared, v1_reserved, v2_reserved. Default mapping: shared consumes first, then reserved. That lets customers reserve capacity for v2 while keeping a safety shared pool.

Maria Gomez: Also need billing wording: if customers use v2 for a request but it's routed to v1 as fallback, bill by the executed model/token cost, not requested version. We'll need to surface routing history in billing exports.

Kevin Wu: Ops: add automatic fallback when v2 autoscaler can't keep up. Include header in fallback response (X-Fallback-Reason: capacity | error | rate_limit). Log sampled request/response pairs for postmortems and add a replay tool.

Olivia Park: UI: will attach mockups here — https://mockups.internal/side-by-side-badge (uploading now). Proposal: show percentage bar in the badge and a small historic sparkline for error_delta.

Alex Chen: Decision sketch: implement server-side header routing + sticky sessions, console badge states + preview button, 1% initial shadow sampling, telemetry metrics as listed, and per-tenant quota buckets. Owners: Samir (routing + fallback), Olivia (console UX + mockups), Maria (billing/telemetry wording). I'll open a spec PR by EOW.

Samir Patel: SG. I'll add a feature flag (routing.side_by_side) and a tenant-level toggle to opt-out of automatic fallback.

Maria Gomez: I'll draft the billing/quotas doc and send to legal/product for a quick review. Also propose an export column actual_executed_version for billing/cost analysis.

Kevin Wu: I'll wire dashboards and alert rules for the new metrics. Quick ask — what should the default alert thresholds be? Leaning p90 latency +20% or error_delta >5% per 10k requests.

Olivia Park: Uploaded mock now. :thumbsup: Also adding a tiny copy note: Preview runs do not count against billing; dry-run only — need confirmation from billing.

Alex Chen: Noted. Maria, please confirm dry-run billing exempt. Action items: Samir open flag PR, Olivia upload final mock and copy, Maria confirm billing + add export field, Kevin create dashboards/alerts. Back here after PRs for a short sync.

Samir Patel: Will do. Adding TODO: add an opt-in console checkbox Disable auto-fallback per tenant.

Maria Gomez: Confirmed on dry-runs — they shouldn't bill, but we need an audit log entry for transparency.

Kevin Wu: Adding alert and a dashboard panel prototype now. Will share link when ready.

Alex Chen: Thanks everyone — closing thread for now, will file the spec with owners and link back. :rocket:
